_source: https://artificialanalysis.ai/ (embedded Next.js flight payload; any /models/<slug> page ships the full set)
_selection: Open-weights models <=200B params, plus all Anthropic, gpt-oss and gemma entries. The full payload is 679 records and is NOT committed -- it regenerates from one curl.
_basis_note: intelligenceIndexIsEstimated is AA's OWN flag. 491 of 679 records are estimates. An estimated score is not a measurement and must not be plotted or ranked as one.
_quantisation_note: AA publishes NO precision/quantisation field. Zero matches for fp8|fp4|int4|int8|4-bit|8-bit|awq|gptq|bf16|quant across all 679 records. Every number here describes whatever precision a host served, unlabelled.
_reproduce: curl -sS -A 'Mozilla/5.0 ... Chrome/130.0' https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/claude-opus-5 | join the self.__next_f.push([1,"..."]) payloads | brace-match objects from {"id":"<uuid>" | keep those with intelligenceIndex and isOpenWeights
